notes.title: "Motherless Vacation Special: Episode 1" DLC Is Out Now!
notes.content:
A year after the epic conclusion of [b]Motherless[/b], the saga continues in a thrilling new chapter. Join Sunny, the 26-year-old head of the world’s most powerful family, as he embarks on a steamy and suspenseful getaway that will test his charm, wit, and courage.

[list][*][i]The full Vacation Special will consist of 3 Episodes in total.[/i][/list]

Out now!

notes.title: Path Viewer Update!
notes.content:
With this update, we are excited to introduce the new Path Viewer Menu. This feature builds upon the functionality of the Scene Replayer, offering an enhanced experience for players. The key distinction of the Path Viewer Menu is the ability to select your favorite girl and seamlessly enjoy all of her scenes in an uninterrupted sequence. It's accessed through the main menu.

Currently only Natassja's path is available, but on the coming days we'll be introducing all the other girls.

Hope you like this update!

notes.title: Patch notes post EP5 release
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [i]Due to saves from previous builds not working properly, a scene navigation system has been added.
[/i]
[/list]

To access it just head to the "Load" menu and click on the "If your saves don't work click here" button. This will take you to a menu similar to the Replay Gallery, but these aren't one-off scenes, since you will be able to continue your game from there.

tags.feature: [i]Due to saves from previous builds not working properly, a scene navigation system has been added.

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
Good day to everybody, we wanted to share a bit of what we are currently working for the game.

[list]
[*] First off, we wanted to make it clear for everyone that if you have purchased the [i]Season 3 DLC[/i], you will get the full season once it comes out. Currently it only consists of Episode 1, but we will be adding episodes as they are made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42823837/f2f03ba7ea069d2dba1e285d8b444ab7da4df885.png[/img]

[*] We have also been working on improving the English dialogue for earlier Chapters, to make the game a more fluid experience.

[*] We have heard of issues while running the game on Steam Deck, and we are currently working on fixing these.

[*] Last but not least, we want to thank everyone for your support and interest in our game, without it we would not have been able to take it this far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42823837/0567f2a3b9adb3639c8fa126db7891e218dc7b31.png[/img]
[/list]

- Mr. Mister and team

[spoiler] [i]P.S. There might me a limited time discount coming your way soon, so be on the lookout![/i][/spoiler]

tags.feature: Currently it only consists of Episode 1, but we will be adding episodes as they are made.
